method: Pooled one-hot ARD Matérn-5/2 GP of full directional OD delays; no PCA
design: continuous LHS with balanced stage labels; independent paired-stage LHS holdout

pooled.prediction_storage: original training targets; exact posterior identity

od.weighting: fixed nominal all-passenger OD collapsed to corridor, reachable off-diagonal
od.uncertainty_note: Latent GP marginal intervals; OD cells are not independent validation samples.
od.normalization: NRMSE is divided by holdout weighted truth RMS; maximum scaled error is the worst case RMSE divided by that case's truth RMS (both use a 0.05-minute floor).

paired_appraisal.reference: Independent heldout MSA OD delays; identical native postprocessing; no new MSA.
paired_appraisal.scope: Paired annual baseline/project matched benefits and physical indicators, not full-future NPV.
paired_appraisal.component_rule: Material mean benefit >= CHF5m/year: MAE <= max(10%, CHF1m/year).
